translation.name: Biblica® Wonhia ɛho kwamma nhoma Akuapem Twi Nkwa Asɛm

content: Dawid dwom a ɔtoo bere a oguan fii Saulo nkyɛn kɔɔ ɔbodan no mu.

content.text: Hu me mmɔbɔ, me Onyankopɔn, hu me mmɔbɔ,
na wo mu na me kra nya guankɔbea.
Wo ntaban nwini ase na mɛpɛ guankɔbea
kosi sɛ amanehunu no betwa mu.
Misu frɛ Onyankopɔn, Ɔsorosoroni no;
Onyankopɔn a ɔma ne pɛ ba mu wɔ me ho.
Ɔsoma fi ɔsoro hɔ begye me nkwa,
ɔka wɔn a wɔtaa me anibere so no anim;
Onyankopɔn soma ne dɔ ne ne nokware.
Gyata atwa me ho ahyia;
meda mmoa a wɔwe nam amono mu,
nnipa a wɔn se te sɛ mpeaw ne mmɛmma
na wɔn tɛkrɛma te sɛ afoa a ɛyɛ nnam.
Onyankopɔn, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma wo so tra ɔsoro,
na ama wʼanuonyam aba asase nyinaa so.
Wɔtrɛw asau mu de sum mʼanan afiri,
ahohiahia brɛɛ me ase.
Wotuu amoa wɔ me kwan mu,
nanso wɔn ankasa akɔtotɔ mu.
Ao, Onyankopɔn, me koma agyina pintinn,
me koma yɛ pintinn;
mɛto dwom na mayi wo ayɛ.
Me kra nyan!
Sanku ne bɛnta, munnyan!
Me nso menyan anɔpahema.
Awurade, mɛkamfo wo wɔ aman no mu;
mɛto wo ho nnwom wɔ nnipa mu.
Wʼadɔe so, ɛkorɔn sen ɔsoro;
wo nokwaredi du wim.
Ao, Onyankopɔn, wɔmma wo so mmoro ɔsoro;
ma wʼanuonyam nkata asase nyinaa so.
Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfo. Wɔto no sɛnea wɔto “Mma Wɔnnsɛe No” sanku nne so.
